name: TART Connect
note: TART's own site lists 4 California zones: Zone 1 (West Shore, Tahoe City, Dollar Hill), Zone 2 (Carnelian Bay, Tahoe Vista, Kings Beach), Zone 3 (Olympic Valley), Zone 4 (Northstar); the page explicitly notes TART Connect does not serve Incline Village, NV. All named communities are unincorporated Placer County, CA. Only Zone 1/2 communities have Census place/CDP boundaries: Tahoe City is CDP 'Sunnyside-Tahoe City'. 'West Shore' and 'Dollar Hill' are represented via the other Zone 1 communities. Olympic Valley/Squaw Valley and Northstar have no Census CDP boundary in Placer County (the only Census place named 'Squaw Valley' in CA is an unrelated Fresno County community), so Zones 3 and 4 are not captured in this polygon; a human should follow up with Placer County GIS for those two zones. Source: https://tahoetruckeetransit.com/tart-connect/
